events.body:
## Context

`background.js` downloads `dataUrl` without checking `chrome.runtime.lastError` (undefined on chrome:// pages and the Web Store). `popup.js` calls `chrome.tabs.sendMessage` with no callback, so "Receiving end does not exist" goes unhandled and the user sees nothing.

## What to do

1. Check `lastError` and `dataUrl` before downloading; show an inline message in the popup.
2. Add tests where the chrome mock sets `lastError`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No uncaught error on chrome://extensions
- [ ] User sees a message
- [ ] New tests pass

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-extension
# then load unpacked and try on chrome://extensions
```
